same_explanation_quote: The Medical Man names the rival — a similar thing at Tübingen, "sleight-of-hand" — and nothing on the list separates them. At this level they are the same explanation of the table.
layer_at_fault_line: The Jobs section tags an added job 'mine' rather than running Add a job; file 33's Step 2 line 'The tag added on a job and the test Add a job in Step 5 are different acts; writing the tag does not run the test' names exactly this trap, which the shared word 'added' still pulled the reader into.
quotes: test_swap: 'swap balloon for tunnel, lift or falling; what survives is only "movement in any dimension has limits"' (P6). test_poke: 'some reading must differ while the machine is there — and stay put when only the reading is changed.' (P10 gauge proposal). test_flip: 'Both directions are covered by the same words: "Into the future or the past — I don't, for certain, know which." The flip of the demonstration itself — nothing happens on the table, and the narrator still swears there was no trickery — would be covered too.' test_reverse: 'Poke the theory (drop P2, change the number of dimensions): the machine's behaviour does not move. Poke the machine (does it vanish?): the theory does not move. The two are joined by assertion, not by a test.' test_hunt: '"No difference... except that our consciousness moves along it" — the exception is the whole thing to be explained and does all the work. So does "a natural infirmity of the flesh, which I will explain to you in a moment."' test_pull (P4|P2): 'the more exactly Time is made like Space, the less anything explains the particular tie between the machine and the direction it moves.' test_patches: 'P10 swallows every failure — unseen at any speed, in either direction.
